description: isometric pixel art building for a fantasy village builder game, bright vivid saturated colours, crisp dark outlines, a single isolated object on a plain background, part of a stone stronghold at the edge of a forest, made of grey hewn stone, heavy timber and iron, standing directly on bare ground with no ground tile, base or platform under it, the watchtower at its grandest: a tall broad grey stone tower with arrow slits over a wide arched gateway with an iron-bound oak gate, a crenellated stone lookout under a peaked wooden shingle roof, a big signal brazier with flames, a horn and long red banners hanging from the top

references.usage: the first, smallest stage of this same building, chosen by the author: keep its stone, timber, roof colours, outlines and pixel style, and draw the bigger, richer next stage of it
